approaches.title: Binary search
approaches.idea: Lower-bound style for "Search in a 2 D matrix".
approaches.code:
def solve(a,x):
    lo,hi=0,len(a)
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if a[mid]<x: lo=mid+1
        else: hi=mid
    return lo
